data.name: tus/tus-js-client
data.enhanced_text:
A pure JavaScript client for the tus resumable upload protocol.

> **tus** is a protocol based on HTTP for _resumable file uploads_. Resumable
> means that an upload can be interrupted at any moment and can be resumed without
> re-uploading the previous data again. An interruption may happen willingly, if
> the user wants to pause, or by accident in case of an network issue or server
tus-js-client is a pure **JavaScript** client for the tus resumable upload protocol and can be used inside **browsers**, **Node.js**,
**React Native** and **Apache Cordova** applications.
This branch contains tus-js-client v4. If you are looking for the previous major release, after which breaking changes have been introduced, please look at the v3.1.3 tag.

data.name: DirectoryLister/DirectoryLister
data.enhanced_text:
📂 Directory Lister is the easiest way to expose the contents of any web-accessible folder for browsing and sharing.

installation you'll be up and running in less than a minute.
Directory Lister is created and maintained by
(@PHLAK.dev) with help through
community contributions.
- **Simple installation** allows you to be up and running in less than a minute.
- **Light and dark themes** to suit your professional needs or personal style.
- **Custom sort ordering** gives you control of the ordering of your files/folders.
- **File search** helps you locate the files you need quickly and efficiently.
- **File hashes** instill confidence when downloading files through verification.
- **Readme rendering** allows exposing the contents of READMEs directly on the page.
- **Zip downloads** for fetching an entire directory of files in a single action.
- **Multi-lingual support** brings Directory Lister to the language of your choice.
- Directory Lister requires PHP >= 8.2
- The Zip extension is required for zip downloads
- The DOM and Fileinfo extensions are required for README rendering
